ops.title: Codex broker live acceptance and final staging gates
ops.body:
2026-09-23 integration checkpoint. User chose automatic broker (note673c5a4); implementation in cc-interact frozen, full race/vet and actual native new-thread broker smoke passed. /tmp/codex-interact-broker-live.log proves real idle Bridge.Deliver started a turn, active delivery joined same turn ID, persisted functionCallOutput provenance/stable IDs, and native model acknowledged both BRIDGE_IDLE_ACK and BRIDGE_ACTIVE_ACK. Consumer tests/builds run against frozen schema2; shared Detach transaction clears native owners. Independent cc-interact review assigned ctx_b05399f02c2a, report /tmp/codex-port-review-interact.txt.
Actual desktop frontend test is task_c9f9cce2840c / ctx_0cd582b700f4, term_8bb22e39-84e1-4552-bde1-0241d69c1115, report /tmp/codex-port-desktop-smoke.txt. Read-only isolated instance only; preserve user's running app. Current desktop bundled CLI0.155.0-alpha.9.2 supersedes old0.142.5 observation.
Full speculative stage2 has28nativeplugins/981files and native installer accepted all28. Captain Hook native packaging added scripts/package-codex.py and test_codex_packaging.py with shared procedure bodies and host frontmatter generation. Stage owner ctx_8d3275b6debb also owns source native MCP correction and minimal host-aware authoring skill instructions. Fleet validator blanket CLAUDE substring ban was refuted for WLM/slop native-first fallbacks and revdiff documentation; removed with focused tests, concrete resource/frontmatter checks retained. Actual Getaway refresh unconditional Claude path assigned explicitly to standalone owner ctx_0beb45f8f767.
Native MCP portable command probe ctx_3e51b28b3e94: compatibility manifests preserve thread cwd but do not expand PLUGIN_ROOT/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT or resolve relative executables. Agent Plugins mode expands paths but forces plugin cwd. Bare PATH executable proof being completed; integration direction is matching source-built CLIs installed under ~/.local/bin ahead of Homebrew, per-link backup, no Homebrew cell overwrites, omitted MCP cwd. No global changes yet.
Claude same-version plugin update retains stale bytes; isolated actual installer accepts build suffix such as1.0.1+codex.1 and picks changed bytes. Stage-only candidate versions must be distinct, originals recorded; preserve full marketplace catalogs, including disabled entries. ccn handshake failure in initial stage was non-Git cwd; same exact binary initializes in Git repo.
ccn owner ctx_e03d53599c9f owns narrow shared patch fixes in transcript and captain-hook. Approved PatchEdit.apply_to(pre_image)->str|None implemented centrally in Rust with private lossless selector/old-new/EOF chunks; existing Hunk public contract retained. Need native matching parity and valid supported patch full images, not silent fragment guard bypass. Anticipated final wheels transcript14.19.0+codex.4 and capt-hook12.51.0+codex.2; previous artifacts provisional. Reviewers notified of narrow drift.
Signing recon report /tmp/codex-port-rollout-recon.txt and note f131303417efd82cfc1290db281adfbdbc248652: zero valid Developer ID identities in configured user/system keychains, missing profiles, installed signed helper schema1 while candidate schema2. Asked user asynchronously to make existing signing assets available via Keychain/Xcode or choose source-only completion with installation pending; NO RESPONSE YET. Do not ask for private keys/passwords. Live rollout cannot use ad-hoc unsigned replacement. Recon worker released successfully. Ten old prior-runtime settled terminal resources remain release_unknown; supported read-only recovery unavailable, preserve unverifiable and no broad cleanup.
